title: A Transfer Learning-Driven Methodology for Efficient and Sustainable Indoor Localization Using VLC
abstract: arXiv:2610.29594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things enables seamless collaboration among connected devices, making indoor localization a critical component of industrial automation. However, conventional localization techniques struggle in dynamic environments. These methods depend on extensive, frequent data collection and environment-specific calibration, limiting scalability, interoperability, and effective use of prior research while imposing significant energy penalties that hinder practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose an energy-efficient transfer learning (TL) based approach for visible light communication based indoor localization. Our method leverages TL to tackle environmental variability, including lighting fluctuations and physical obstacles that typically degrade localization performance, while simultaneously reducing computational overhead and energy consumption compared to conventional approaches. translated_abstract: 物联网的快速扩张使得联网设备之间能够无缝协作，室内定位因此成为工业自动化的关键组成部分。然而，传统定位技术在动态环境中表现不佳。这些方法依赖于大量且频繁的数据收集以及针对特定环境的校准，限制了可扩展性和互操作性，也未能有效利用已有的研究成果，同时带来显著的能耗代价，阻碍了实际部署。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于迁移学习（TL）的节能方法，用于基于可见光通信的室内定位。我们的方法利用迁移学习来应对环境变化，包括光照波动和物理障碍物等通常会降低定位性能的因素，同时与传统方法相比，降低了计算开销和能耗。我们还……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于迁移学习的可见光通信室内定位方法，能够有效应对光照波动和物理障碍等环境变化，同时显著降低计算开销与能耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transfer learning-based methodology for VLC indoor localization that effectively handles environmental variability such as lighting fluctuations and physical obstacles while reducing computational overhead and energy consumption compared to conventional approaches.
